objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Abuse the way the shop builds its LDAP queries to read directory entries that are not fruit or vegetables. The flag is the description of one of the directory's users.
hints: View the page source of an item page: the shop prints the LDAP search filter it used in an HTML comment.
The item page puts your value into the filter unescaped and lets you choose which attributes come back. Which vulnerability class is that?

steps.title: Find the page
steps.prompt: Which shop page shows one stock item and takes the item's name in the URL? (its path)

steps.title: Find the input
steps.prompt: Which query string parameter of that page goes into the LDAP filter unescaped?

steps.title: Choose the attributes
steps.prompt: Which query string parameter decides which LDAP attributes the page displays?
